== Description ==

At a table at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025: [[Ken Cross]] (front left, grey and black Columbia fleece and rimless glasses), [[Jonny Chu]] (back left, black hoodie and glasses), and [[Paul Coggins]] (right, black 311 cap and plaid shirt), with a fourth player in a black zip hoodie (centre, unlabeled) and standing players behind (unlabeled).
